$description: Hand-written. Corner radius, the same in every mode. A short ladder biased sharp (Bennett, 2026-10-08: 'intentionally less rounded than your typical vibed corner'): md is the default, lg only for the outer of two nested rounded things, sm only for marks too small for md. Replaces v1's --border-radius-XS…XL for v2.

sm.$description: Small marks: checkboxes, swatch chips, a file input's button.

md.$description: The default: buttons, fields, tiles, cards that hold no rounded children.

lg.$description: The outer of two nested rounded things: a panel holding fields or tiles.

full.$description: Fully round ends: toggles, pills, dots.
